title: Catalysts: Jewellery Quality, Implicit Scaling and Combining
summary: Catalysts add catalyst-quality to rings, amulets and belts, boosting the item's implicit modifier in a specific category (resistances, attributes, life, defences, charges, flasks or gems). This guide covers which catalyst does what, how far quality stacks, and how to reroll the boosted implicit.
description: A source-linked reference for Catalysts in Path of Exile 2: the eight catalyst types, how quality scales implicits, stacking caps, and combining at the Reforging Bench.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Path of Exile 2 Catalyst currency items - vials that add quality to jewellery to scale a specific implicit modifier

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: Right-click a Catalyst on a ring, amulet or belt to add catalyst-quality. The catalyst type decides which implicit modifier the quality boosts (resistances, attributes, life, defences, charges, flasks or socketed gems). Up to 20% quality; each use adds 5%.
calloutDetail: Quality from catalysts is separate from crafting-quality and scales the item's native implicit, not a random roll.
Using a different catalyst type swaps which implicit is boosted; using the same type adds more quality toward the 20% cap.

answers.label: Use for
text: A jewellery piece whose implicit (e.g. +resistances, +attributes) you want scaled higher.

answers.label: Check first
text: Confirm which implicit the catalyst boosts by hovering the item - the quality line names the category.

answers.label: Avoid
text: Wasting catalysts on an item whose implicit you will replace (e.g. via an Essence or a new base).

sections.title: The eight catalysts
intro: Each catalyst adds quality that scales one implicit category on the jewellery it is used on. Hover the target item to see exactly which implicit the quality affects before you commit.

members.title: Abrasive Catalyst
body: Boosts the implicit that grants elemental resistances (fire/cold/lightning). Best on rings and amulets that already grant resistances.

members.title: Turbulent Catalyst
body: Boosts attribute implicits. Strong on amulets that grant +attributes or mixed stat lines.

members.title: Intrinsic Catalyst
body: Boosts life and energy-shield implicits. A default choice for defensive jewellery.

members.title: Fundamental Catalyst
body: Boosts armour, evasion and energy-shield implicits.

members.title: Imbued Catalyst
body: Boosts the level of socketed skill and support gems. Valuable on amulets that hold a key skill gem.

members.title: Violet Catalyst
body: Boosts charge-related implicits (e.g. charge generation or maximum charges).

members.title: Dense Catalyst
body: Boosts flask-effect and flask-charge implicits on belts and jewellery.

members.title: Prismatic Catalyst
body: Boosts a broad all-attributes implicit. Use when you want generic stat scaling.

sections.title: What you can catalyse
note: Catalysts only work on jewellery. They scale the item's existing implicit - they do not add a new modifier.

sections.title: How to get Catalysts
intro: Catalysts are a common currency drop and are widely available.

routes.label: Monster drops
body: Drop from normal and magic monsters throughout the campaign and endgame.

routes.label: Vendor recipes
body: Some NPC vendors sell catalysts or accept lower-tier currency in trade.

routes.label: Currency Exchange
body: Trade excess currency for the specific catalyst type you need.

routes.label: Reforging Bench combine
body: Combine three of one type to produce a higher-tier result (see crafting).

steps.label: Hover the item
body: Mouse over your ring/amulet/belt; the implicit line shows which category quality currently boosts.

steps.label: Pick the catalyst
body: Choose the catalyst type matching the implicit you want scaled.

steps.label: Right-click apply
body: Right-click the catalyst then click the jewellery. Quality rises by 5%.

steps.label: Repeat to cap
body: Keep applying the same type up to 20% total quality.

sections.title: Combining and rerolling
paragraphs: At the Reforging Bench you can combine three catalysts of the same type into a single higher-tier catalyst. The higher tier grants the same implicit boost but is more efficient per apply (reaching the 20% cap in fewer uses).

If you have applied the wrong catalyst type, the quality currently boosts an unwanted implicit. Because catalyst quality is tied to the last catalyst type used, applying a different type swaps the boosted category - but it does not refund the quality already invested. Plan the catalyst type before you start, or accept the swap and rebuild quality from there.

Catalyst quality and crafting-quality are independent. A jewellery item can carry both: crafting-quality from a quality currency and catalyst-quality from catalysts, each scaling different things (crafted mods vs the implicit).
bullets: Combine 3 same-type catalysts -> 1 higher-tier catalyst at the Reforging Bench.
Same-type apply = +5% quality toward the 20% cap.
Different-type apply = swaps the boosted implicit category.
Catalyst quality and crafting quality stack independently.

sections.title: Which builds catalyse what
intro: Catalysts are a finishing touch. Apply them after the base implicit and other crafts are settled, so the scaled implicit is the one you keep.

builds.title: Bow / attribute stackers
builds.description: Turbulent or Prismatic Catalyst on the amulet to push attribute implicits.

builds.title: Tanky life builds
builds.description: Intrinsic Catalyst on rings/belts for more life implicit.

builds.title: Gem-socket amulets
builds.description: Imbued Catalyst when a key skill or support gem is socketed in the amulet.

builds.title: Flask-reliant builds
builds.description: Dense Catalyst on belts for flask effect and charges.

entries.question: I used an Abrasive Catalyst on a ring that had no resistance implicit - did I waste it?
summary: A player catalysed an item whose implicit did not match the catalyst category.
editorialAnalysis: Catalyst quality scales the implicit that matches the catalyst category. If the item has no such implicit, the quality has nothing to boost and is effectively wasted.
officialAnswer: Only catalyse items whose implicit matches the catalyst type.

entries.question: Can I go past 20% catalyst quality?
summary: Players asked whether quality keeps climbing.
editorialAnalysis: Catalyst quality caps at 20%. Further applications of the same type are wasted; a different type would swap the boosted implicit instead of adding more.

directAnswer: The catalyst type did not match any implicit on the item, so there was no matching modifier to scale.
checks: Hover the item and read which implicit the quality line names before applying.

directAnswer: You used a different catalyst type than intended; the boosted category swapped.
checks: Re-apply the correct type; note the prior quality is not refunded.

directAnswer: You hit the catalyst-quality cap. Further same-type applies do nothing.
checks: Stop catalysing; the implicit is at its scaled maximum.

items.title: Essences
items.description: Essences reroll an item's implicit - decide that before catalysing.

changes: Catalysts introduced as the jewellery quality currency, scaling a specific implicit by catalyst type up to 20%.
Catalysts remain the jewellery-quality currency; the eight-type system and 20% cap are current.
